description: This Kotlin source file defines the class DbUpdateChecker, which manages app update checks within an Android environment, interfacing with a database and package manager to determine updatable apps and suggested versions.

classes.name: DbUpdateChecker
classes.description: A class responsible for checking and retrieving information about app updates, including listing updatable apps and suggesting versions based on package info and preferences.

methods.name: getUpdatableApps
methods.description: Returns a list of apps that can be updated, considering release channels, preferred repositories, and vulnerabilities.

methods.name: getSuggestedVersion
methods.description: Provides a suggested app version for a given package, potentially for update or installation.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Internal method to determine the appropriate version based on available versions, package info, and preferences.

methods.name: getUpdatableApp
methods.description: Constructs an UpdatableApp object with detailed info about the update.
